content.bridge_context: Learning about how towns and cities are managed by local bodies like Municipal Corporations.

units.title: Urban Local Bodies
units.explanation: Municipalities and Municipal Corporations look after the needs of people living in cities.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name the city you live in. Is there a 'Nagar Nigam'? / आप किस शहर में रहते हैं? क्या वहाँ 'नगर निगम' है?

units.title: City Services
units.explanation: Cities need more complex services like garbage collection, street lights, and large hospitals.
units.dual_language_instruction: Who collects the garbage from your house every day? / हर दिन आपके घर से कूड़ा कौन इकट्ठा करता है?
